Your employees' wellbeing, looked after on the ground

Far from home, it is the small things that weigh: an empty fridge on the first evening, a dry cleaner nobody can find, a Sunday alone in a city you do not know. We take care of them, so your employees focus on the assignment and keep a good memory of it.

Wellbeing on assignment is an HR matter, not a luxury

An employee on a long assignment accumulates causes of fatigue: a home that is not theirs, meals eaten on the go, no exercise, few social ties, a family left behind. The consequences are measurable: loss of focus, sick leave, refusal of the next assignment, sometimes resignation on return. For construction crews, add the risks that come with lack of rest.

Wellbeing services answer these concrete situations. They are not gimmicks: they are what allows a person to live well for weeks or months away from home, and your company to keep its talent. You choose the services useful for each assignment; we organise them and invoice them on the same quote as the housing.

À la carte or as a full programme

Welcome and settling-in

Fridge stocked on arrival, welcome kit, tour of the apartment and neighbourhood, help with everyday admin (travel pass, doctor, pharmacy, gym). Your employee feels expected from the first evening.

Concierge during the stay

Cleaning, laundry, groceries, restaurant bookings, deliveries, small repairs, parcels: one number to call for everything that is not the job. In English and French.

Sport and activities

Gym membership near the apartment, swimming pool, group classes, discovering Paris, team outings: what keeps balance and motivation on long assignments.

Family support

For expatriations and relocations: school or nursery search, childcare, helping the partner settle, administrative appointments. A well-settled family means a focused employee.

The first evening

It is the most sensitive moment of an assignment. Your employee arrives tired, often late, in a city they do not know. We make sure they find a clean, heated apartment, a fridge with dinner and breakfast in it, working wifi, and someone to call with a question.

The next day, if you wish, we show them the neighbourhood: where to shop, where to catch the metro, where to run in the morning. One hour that changes the rest of the stay.

A programme built with you

Every company and every employee is different. Anna, our head of premium services, builds the programme with you: a few à la carte services for a three-week assignment, full support for a two-year expatriation with a family.

You decide what is included, we take care of the rest, and you receive one quote. During the assignment your employee can request extra services; they are submitted to you for approval before being committed.

Three sample programmes

Three-week assignment, a technician alone. Fridge stocked on arrival, a tour of the neighbourhood the first morning, laundry and gym membership near the apartment, one number for the unexpected. Not much, but the things that matter when you do not know the city.

Six-month engagement, a consultant Monday to Thursday. Welcome and settling-in, weekly cleaning, dry cleaning, restaurant bookings for client dinners, gym membership, and a recurring transfer to the station on Thursday evenings to fly home.

Two-year expatriation, an executive with family. Temporary housing then a family apartment, school and nursery search, support for the partner's paperwork, help with administrative registrations, discovering Paris as a family on the first weekend, concierge for the whole contract. A programme built with HR at head office, in English, and delivered on the ground, in French.

What it changes for you

A well-settled employee sleeps better, works better and is happier to accept the next assignment.

Assignments that go smoothly
Fewer calls to HR, fewer logistics issues raised by your teams, fewer delays.
Talent you keep
The welcome given to a travelling employee counts for retention, especially if they travel often.
An employer brand
Your employees talk about their assignment. A good welcome in Paris becomes a recruiting argument.
One contact
Housing, transport and services are managed by the same team and invoiced together.

Wellbeing questions

Are the services compulsory with the housing?

No. You can give us the housing alone. Services are à la carte, and you choose what is useful for each assignment.

Can you support construction crews?

Yes: arrival groceries, cleaning, laundry, gym membership, meal arrangements. Rested, well-fed crews are crews that last the length of a project.

How are services invoiced?

On the same quote as the housing, itemised per service. Extra requests during the stay are submitted to you for approval before being committed.

Do you speak languages other than English and French?

We work in English and French. For other languages we rely on partners as needed: tell us when we prepare the quote.
